tasks.subject: Close self-approval bypass in firestore.rules
tasks.description: Restrict writes to users/{userId} so status/role cannot be client-modified. Options: (a) field-level restrictions in rules, or (b) move status/role to server-controlled collection admin/userStatus/{uid} writable only by admin/owner custom claim. Update rules and any client reads accordingly.
tasks.output: Closed self-approval bypass in firestore.rules by adding field-level restrictions. Users can now read/write their own user document but CANNOT modify 'status' or 'role' fields. Only users with admin/owner custom claims can write these protected fields. Updated rules cover: read (owner), update (owner, excluding status/role), create (owner, excluding status/role), and full write (admin/owner via custom claims). No client code changes needed - AdminService already validates admin status before writing status/role.

acceptanceResults.criterion: Users cannot modify their own status/role fields
acceptanceResults.evidence: Rules at lines 21-22 and 25-26 explicitly block writes to status/role for owner updates/creates

acceptanceResults.criterion: Admins/owners can still manage user status/role
acceptanceResults.evidence: Rules at lines 29-30 allow write for request.auth.token.role == 'admin' || 'owner'
AuthService reads status/role (unchanged); AdminService writes status only after _isAdmin check; SyncService writes to subcollections (unaffected)

commandsRun.evidence: AuthService only reads user document for status/role (lines 113-121)

tasks.subject: Add Cloud Function (Admin SDK) for custom claims + user doc creation
tasks.description: Create functions/ directory with: (1) onCreate auth trigger → create users/{uid} doc with status:'pending' + accessRequests/{uid}; (2) onUpdate of admin/userStatus/{uid} → set admin/owner custom claims on approved/suspended users. Deploy to Firebase. Ensure Admin SDK dependency added.

tasks.subject: Wire Firebase from build config (--dart-define)
tasks.description: Replace hardcoded firebaseConfigured: false in main.dart with proper FirebaseOptions injection via --dart-define / firebase_options.dart pattern. Add build flavors or dart-define for projectId, apiKey, etc. Remove FirestoreOptionsProvider.isConfigured hardcoded false.

tasks.subject: Fix Firestore indexes & health subcollection path
tasks.description: Update firestore.indexes.json: lastChecked → checkedAt. Add rule for providers/{providerId}/health/{healthId} or repoint ProviderHealth.publish to providerHealth/{providerId}. Ensure indexes match actual written fields.

tasks.subject: TMDB key injection via dart-define + header + visible error
tasks.description: Remove YOUR_TMDB_API_KEY_HERE default in tmdb_service.dart. Inject key via --dart-define=TMDB_API_KEY=xxx. Send as Authorization header instead of query param. Add visible config error UI when key missing/invalid instead of silently returning empty results.

tasks.subject: Fix search rendering — store results, build grid
tasks.description: In search_screen.dart: store onMovies/onSeries callback results in state, replace placeholder Text with grid using CinemaCard + cached_network_image. Add loading/error states. Tap result → ContentDetailScreen.

tasks.subject: Wire Home catalogue — trending + popular sections
tasks.description: In home_screen.dart: call CatalogueService.getTrending(), getPopularMovies(), getPopularSeries() on init. Render horizontal scrolling sections with CinemaCard. Tap → ContentDetailScreen. Add shimmer while loading.

tasks.subject: Wire Details TMDB metadata — render _meta
tasks.description: In content_detail_screen.dart: render _meta data (cast, similar titles, genres, runtime) in appropriate sections. Fix backdrop to use TMDB backdropUrl from _meta when constructor arg is null. Remove unused_field flags.

tasks.subject: Wire Library watchlist/history from SyncService/Firestore
tasks.description: In library_screen.dart: read watchlist and watchHistory from SyncService/Firestore. Render lists with CinemaCard. Tap → ContentDetailScreen. Handle empty states.

tasks.subject: Expand test suite — widget tests for wired screens
tasks.description: Add widget tests for: search results grid, home sections, detail metadata rendering, library list. Mock Firebase/Firestore/Providers. Ensure flutter test passes on CI.

tasks.subject: Auth flow validation with Cloud Function emulator
tasks.description: Test sign-in → pending → approve flow using Firebase emulator suite. Verify custom claims are set and rules enforce them. Add integration test.

tasks.subject: Regression smoke tests after each milestone
tasks.description: Run flutter analyze + flutter test after each task completion. Document any new warnings. Gate merges on zero errors.
